name: Cummins 4BT
notes: Classic industrial/agricultural Cummins B-series four, a long-popular swap engine independent of the newer R2.8 crate motor. Factory ratings varied widely by application - common baseline is 105hp/265lb-ft (359Nm), but aftercooled/intercooled versions reached up to 150hp/420lb-ft (569Nm). Mechanical P7100-family injection pump, no ECU - confirmed directly by a cataloged real build using this exact pump.
